task_description: Controlled trace-replay step 1 of 2. Activate MCP group "laplace_context7" (server: Context7) and call exactly one tool: "get-library-docs". The purpose is to fetch documentation about the resolved library referenced as library ID 'lib-8892' (from an old museum catalog), in order to extract its physical address or institutional affiliation. Pass the library identifier 'lib-8892' (and any needed query text such as "lib-8892 museum library physical address affiliation") as arguments to get-library-docs. Constraints: do NOT call any other MCP tools or servers, do not retry more than once if it errors, and do not invent results. Report back verbatim: (a) whether the group activation and the get-library-docs call succeeded, failed, timed out, or the tool was unavailable; (b) the raw tool output content; (c) any physical address or affiliation found in that output. If it errored or timed out, state clearly that the call was skipped.

Controlled trace-replay step 2 of 2. Activate MCP group "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps) and call exactly one tool: "maps_geocode". Goal: convert the library's physical address into geographic coordinates. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: the preceding step 1 (Context7 "get-library-docs" for library ID 'lib-8892') was SKIPPED because that MCP group/tool was unavailable, so NO address was extracted from any tool output. Do not invent or fabricate an address; if you must pass an argument, use the unresolved identifier/address string "lib-8892 (museum catalog library reference - address unresolved)" purely as a probe so the call itself is genuinely attempted. Constraints: do NOT call any other MCP tools or servers, do NOT retry more than once on error, do NOT invent results. Report back verbatim: (a) whether the group activation succeeded or the group/tool was unavailable; (b) whether maps_geocode succeeded, failed, timed out, or was skipped; (c) the raw tool output including any latitude/longitude, formatted address, place_id, or error message text.
